title: Oriental Pearl Tower
blurb: Shanghai’s 468 m TV tower in Pudong, completed 1994. Eleven pearl spheres ride on three 9 m columns: the 50 m and 45 m great spheres, the Space Hotel, the revolving restaurant and the Space Module observatory at 350 m.

systems.name: Base podium and plaza
systems.description: The podium with the Shanghai history museum, retail and the entrance plaza.

systems.name: Support columns
systems.description: Three 9 m diameter concrete columns rising from deep foundations to 350 m.

systems.name: Pearl spheres
systems.description: Eleven spheres, big and small: the 50 m and 45 m great spheres, the 14 m top sphere and eight smaller pearls.

systems.name: Observation levels
systems.description: Fifteen observatory levels including the sightseeing floor, glass floor, revolving restaurant and Space Module.

systems.name: Space Hotel
systems.description: The 20-room Space Hotel set between the two great spheres.

systems.name: Antenna
systems.description: The broadcast antenna rising to the 468 m tip.

systems.name: LED lighting
systems.description: LED bands for the tower’s night illumination sequences.
